name: Mirugeki 2: Papa tte Yobitai no
original_name: みるげき2 パパってよびたいの
source:
Father suddenly remarries one day, so main character who attends college acquires a new mother and a younger sister. There is a big age difference, so sister calls protagonist "papa" for some reason. But somehow sister's behavior is far from childish, she is definitely longing for sex...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，父亲突然再婚。就读大学的主人公因此有了新母亲和妹妹。由于年龄差距较大，妹妹不知为何叫主人公“爸爸”。然而，妹妹的行为一点也不孩子气，她显然渴望性爱……

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]）
